title: Add peek to the Stack module
starter:
module Stack = struct
  type t = int list
  let empty = []
  let push x s = x :: s
  let pop s = match s with [] -> None | x :: rest -> Some (x, rest)
  let peek s = None
end
hints: `peek` looks at the top without taking it off. It's `pop` without the rest of the stack.
Inside the module, `t` is an `int list`, so the top is the head of the list: `match s with [] -> None | x :: _ -> Some x`.

answer.code:
module Stack = struct
  type t = int list
  let empty = []
  let push x s = x :: s
  let pop s = match s with [] -> None | x :: rest -> Some (x, rest)
  let peek s = match s with [] -> None | x :: _ -> Some x
end
answer.explain: The reference is `let peek s = match s with [] -> None | x :: _ -> Some x`. Inside `struct ... end` the stack is a plain list, so the top is the list's head. From outside, you call it as `Stack.peek`.
